coverage_heuristics.notes: Pure app-domain story: no API endpoints, no auth surfaces. Negative paths covered via reducedMotion true branch (setValue early return not duration:0), runtime unmount mid-fade, emptyBoard / full-but-mergeable edge (W-005), zero-merge streak reset. UI journey is state-overlay (isGameOver -> {gameOver ? <GameOverOverlay : null} sibling to frozen GameBoard) not a route — E2E intentionally N/A (same posture as 6.1/7.1/7.2). Error handling pinned as state-not-error: deterministic pure projection (matchStats 10) + thin-view guards (ui.norolls/ui.thinview/engine.purity green). Haptics/sound not gated here (Epic 8 owns expo-haptics/expo-audio, stripped source proves absence).
